_meta.method: native read-only audit by AutoCoder (subagent model quota exhausted)
_meta.evidenceDiscipline: every finding is CONFIRMED BUG / CONFIRMED GAP / ALREADY CORRECT / NOT REPRODUCED / DEFERRED, with file:line evidence

findings.title: Session cookie config
findings.evidence: routes/auth.ts:85-92 COOKIE_OPTIONS = httpOnly:true, sameSite:'lax', path:'/', secure:NODE_ENV==='production', maxAge:30d; server.ts registers @fastify/cookie; config-audit.ts:137-142 actively audits the production-secure-over-http footgun
findings.residualRisk: An expired 30-day session is deleted lazily and returns 401 while the UI still looks logged in (lib/auth.ts resolveSession). Spec item 12 symptom class. NOT REPRODUCED as a bug; synthetic-driver timing remains a candidate (spec item 54). Phase E: add auth observability events + frontend 401 recovery, no rewrite.

findings.title: No auth/session events + no frontend 401 recovery flow
findings.evidence: No auth.* events anywhere in src (grep); copilot-errors.ts maps 401 to generic text only; api.ts has no 401-specific handling

findings.title: IANA timezone storage
findings.evidence: schema.prisma:61-62 User.timezone IANA String @default('UTC'); Goal.timezone per goal (schema:136-138); domain/dates.ts uses Intl.DateTimeFormat with timeZone; notifications tested per-user local clock (daily-notifications.test.ts:71-72)

findings.title: UTC fallback paths in Copilot logic
findings.evidence: two non-test call sites use todayIn('UTC') instead of the user's timezone: services/copilot-session.ts:346 (frequency-conflict first-question parse) and ai/feasibility.ts:95 (deadline window check)
findings.impact: low-severity: both only compare relative day differences for 'short window' logic and 'N days vs allowed days'; a user near midnight with a 'by <date>' phrase could get a 1-day-off verdict
findings.fixPhase: F (pass user timezone into both; tests)

findings.title: DST transition tests
findings.evidence: daily-notifications.test.ts covers midnight wrap + tz windows, but no test crosses a DST boundary

findings.title: All scheduling day-boundaries use goal/user timezone
findings.evidence: every scheduling route computes today via goalToday(goal) (goals.ts, tasks.ts, misc.ts, social.ts, progression.ts, adjustments.ts, copilot-goal.ts); grep shows zero scheduling uses of server-local new Date() for day strings
findings.note: new Date() is only used for timestamps (createdAt etc.), which is correct

findings.title: Streak/rest-day semantics
findings.evidence: domain/scoring.ts computeStreak: day.percent===null (nothing required) is neutral and skipped in both current and best streak walks; 'Tue REST, Mon/Wed complete' keeps the streak. Historical progress is derived from the completions list, never erased.

findings.title: MISSED status never persisted
findings.evidence: OCCURRENCE_STATUS includes 'MISSED' (enums.ts:39) but grep found zero code writing status:'MISSED'; overdue occurrences simply remain PENDING and are scored as unsatisfied by date math
findings.impact: no hook for missed-task recovery UX, adaptive catch-up, or occurrence.missed events (spec items 17, 20, 25, 47)

findings.title: No RESCHEDULED status / move-to-day flow
findings.evidence: tasks.ts:209 only SKIPPED; no endpoint moves an occurrence to another day; spec items 19, 21-23 have no implementation

findings.title: Difficulty-derived adaptation exists
findings.evidence: services/adjustments.ts + domain/adjustment.ts build TOO_EASY/TOO_HARD offers from ratings + ladders; applied only through existing progression endpoints the user approves (no silent AI mutation) - matches spec item 24/23
findings.missing: missed-task-driven rebalance proposals (spec item 25) - part of A8/A9 work

findings.title: Completion -> coins -> achievements chain
findings.status: ALREADY CORRECT with a transaction-safety gap
findings.evidence: routes/tasks.ts complete(): occurrence->COMPLETED, grantReward (RewardTransaction with taskOccurrenceId @unique -> idempotent), computeStreak persisted, evaluateAchievements -> unlockAchievement pre-checks @@unique(userId, achievementId)
findings.gap: the occurrence update, reward grant, streak write, and achievement unlock are separate statements, not one prisma.$transaction - a crash between them can desync coins/occurrence (spec item 37 wants one authoritative event)
findings.fixPhase: I (wrap in a transaction or event-outbox; add item-39 first-completion regression test)

findings.title: Intent routing
findings.evidence: no classifier exists; the widget routes only by view buttons (create/goal/help); any text typed in 'create' becomes initialGoalText of an interview (CopilotWidget -> useCopilotInterview.startInterview)

findings.title: Interview answer interception
findings.evidence: answers go through the answers endpoint bound to a question id, not through a free-text router; interruption support is new work in Phase B
findings.fixPhase: B (interruption answering while keeping the pending question)

findings.title: Session survives refresh
findings.evidence: server state is authoritative and resumable via GET /copilot/goal-sessions/:id (snapshot includes pending question when INTERVIEWING), and useCopilotInterview(resumeSessionId) exists - but NOBODY persists the active sessionId client-side; a hard refresh loses it and the widget starts a NEW session on the next 'create' (duplicate-session risk)
findings.fixPhase: C (persist active session id, restore on reopen; spec items 6, 7)

findings.title: Generation state machine / idempotent build / no infinite spinner
findings.evidence: the session row's GENERATING status is the only in-flight marker; no PlanGenerationState entity, no idempotency key, api.ts has NO fetch timeout, CopilotWidget 'Building your plan...' has no slow-generation fallback (spec items 8-11)

findings.title: Stale goal context indicator
findings.evidence: CopilotProvider.target persists while the modal stays open across route changes (pathname does not reset target); no 'Discussing: <goal>' label, no clear-context button (spec items 35, 36)

findings.title: Deterministic loading/error/empty states
findings.evidence: components/ui.tsx useAsync always terminates (finally clears loading, error state on catch); all pages listing data (MyGoals, Dashboard, Discover, Friends, Leaderboard, Rewards, Profile, GoalDetail, DraftReview, JoinByCode, CreateGoalChoice) consume it with Skeleton/ErrorState(retry)/EmptyState
findings.residual: action-button handlers (GoalManage, ProgressionPanel, ShareGoalModal, TaskRow, AiMemoryPanel forget actions) do local try/catch toasts - no infinite-skeleton class found; Phase H does a final pass with the ViewState contract for non-useAsync fetchers

findings.title: Category -> icon/emoji mapping
findings.status: CONFIRMED BUG (manual path) + GAP (validation of AI path)
findings.evidence: web/src/pages/CreateGoal.tsx:71 defaults category to 'FITNESS' and the category selector is on the form; a user who skips the selector gets Fitness (weightlifter emoji, types.ts CATEGORY_EMOJI) for 'Read Books'. The Copilot path is protected differently: ai/category.ts classifyGoalText is deterministic (verified: 'Read books' -> READING @1.0) and overrides the model's guess at copilot-draft.ts:323-325; goalDraftSchema validates category against GOAL_CATEGORY (z.enum, schemas.ts:177), so an out-of-enum model category cannot persist - but nothing forces a neutral fallback when BOTH the model and the text guess fail, since GOAL_CATEGORY has no null and draft.category is required
findings.fix: H: default manual form to 'OTHER' (or infer from title), ensure the Copilot draft falls back to 'OTHER' when confidence is low instead of trusting the model

findings.title: Disabled primary actions without explanation
findings.evidence: ProgressionPanel.tsx:657 'Add progression' disabled when !valid (targets empty/not climbing) with only opacity dimming, no inline message; spec item 33 wants a reason
findings.fix: H (inline validation text like 'Enter increasing stage targets first')

findings.title: Dropdown styling/overlap
findings.status: NOT REPRODUCED (code) - DEFERRED to visual QA
findings.evidence: index.css:165-189 styles native selects (focus ring, option colors); native <select> popups are browser-rendered and cannot overlap the header the way custom popovers can; three selects exist (GoalManage:98, ProgressionPanel:546, CreateGoal:568) - all native
findings.fix: H visual pass (spec item 45) will confirm on mobile widths

findings.title: Suppressed-question dead end (found during audit)
findings.status: CONFIRMED BUG - FIXED during Phase A
findings.evidence: copilot-session.ts applyTurn keyed the 'That's everything I need.' fallback to the redundancy reason only; other suppression reasons left a question message with no answer input. Fixed in commit 8fd6763 (keyed off the final question) + acceptance test; suite green after fix

findings.title: Frequency-conflict widget dead end
findings.evidence: commit 89fe379: FREQUENCY_CONFLICT released the session to READY_TO_GENERATE so the widget showed 'Build my plan' over an unanswered stored question; now releases to INTERVIEWING and the web hook adopts the snapshot

findings.title: Structured events for Copilot/scheduling
findings.evidence: CopilotEvent model exists with SESSION_STARTED/QUESTION_ANSWERED/DRAFT_GENERATED; no auth.* events, no occurrence.missed/rescheduled, no plan.rebalance.*
findings.fixPhase: E (auth), G (scheduling); copilot events extended in B/C/D
